physical.control_rationale: V1 whole-horizon 24-column responses were nearly redundant at the final hold (stored condition estimates ~1e10), with a SLSQP linesearch failure. Retain each actual failed BF7 input as a baseline; change only the later two knot offsets (12 active columns) while always replaying the full horizon from zero. This is not a derivative guarantee.
physical.acceptance: Original registered evaluate.reach and offline Reach/Hold acceptance on complete 600-step runs, terminal 10mm, four inclusive holding samples with 10mm/30mm_s bounds, force bounds and solver validity; joint SELECT only with three passing owned independent replays on identical structure/discretization.
physical.stop: Test first new structure across all three v1 targets. First full independent joint pass SELECT and stop R2 scientific work. Only if no joint pass, test the second new structure within its separate cap. No further automatic continuation, no task relaxation.
